terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using CoWorker you agree to these terms.

rules.content: You are responsible for the content you post and must follow the Review Guidelines.
rules.genuine: Reviews must reflect your genuine professional experience.
rules.suspension: We may hide or remove content and suspend accounts that break these terms.
rules.limit: You may post up to 5 reviews per day.

guidelines.title: Review Guidelines

rules.experience: Only review people you have actually worked with. Reviews must be based on real professional experience.
rules.conduct: No personal attacks, insults, harassment, or hateful language.
rules.facts: Stick to facts. Do not post false or misleading information.
rules.privacy: No spam, advertising, or private information such as phone numbers or addresses.
rules.onePerPerson: One review per person. You can edit or delete your own review at any time.

guidelines.footer: Reviews that break these rules may be hidden or removed by our moderators.
